messages.content: Leaving out beneficiaries of unknown age, what was the amount reimbursed for each age bracket in claims processed in January 2025? Return each bracket's name and the amount.

content.text: Good! Now I understand the structure. Let me check the data to see what age brackets are available and how to identify January 2025:

input.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT AGE_BEN_SNDS, AGE_BEN_SNDS_LIB 
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_AGE_BRACKET 
ORDER BY AGE_BEN_SNDS

content.text: Perfect! Now let me check how dates are stored and identify January 2025 records:

input.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT FLX_ANN_MOI, SOI_ANN, SOI_MOI 
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS 
WHERE FLX_ANN_MOI >= 202401 AND FLX_ANN_MOI <= 202501
ORDER BY FLX_ANN_MOI DESC
LIMIT 20

content.text: Now let me get the reimbursement amounts by age bracket for January 2025, excluding the "AGE INCONNU" (unknown age) bracket:

input.sql:
SELECT 
    d.AGE_BEN_SNDS_LIB,
    SUM(f.PRS_REM_MNT + f.FLT_REM_MNT) as TOTAL_REIMBURSED
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS f
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_AGE_BRACKET d ON f.AGE_BEN_SNDS = d.AGE_BEN_SNDS
WHERE f.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202501
  AND f.AGE_BEN_SNDS <> 99  -- Exclude unknown age
GROUP BY d.AGE_BEN_SNDS_LIB, f.AGE_BEN_SNDS
ORDER BY f.AGE_BEN_SNDS
